notes.text: Codification Section, Pub. L. 106–568, title XIV, § 1402, Dec. 27, 2000, 114 Stat. 2939, which set out congressional findings, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

Short TitlePub. L. 106–568, title XIV, § 1401, Dec. 27, 2000, 114 Stat. 2939, provided that title XIV of Pub. L. 106–568, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Graton Rancheria Restoration Act”.
